title: S1 Elite Framework Resilience: independent full-stack original-repo execution audit
question: Adversarially audit and solve the highest-value REAL bottlenecks in the seven-track owner-approved comprehensive S1 Elite mission brief (the source-frozen full original brief is among public evidence_files). Distinguish described/tool/manual/scheduled-S1/main/natural-consumer proofs and investigate causal dependency edges across actual GitHub workflows, authentic original owner/actor, source lease, tests, high-impact release, 7-day Kompas forecast, Alpha Lab, Strategist research handoff, and GET-only API accounting. Identify Top 5 concrete P0 original-owned source repairs with smallest code/test/CI/release patches, existing owner and exact first-known proof. Point out what cannot honestly be executed, requires independent external evidence or must ABSTAIN. Quantify priority by downstream unblockable workflows, not number of files. Identify three genuinely novel architecture faults if supported, else abstain. No hypothetical acceptance receipt or fake paid-response proof.
hypothesis: Bounded reuse of existing Research Lab, S1 Supervisor, Strategist and GitHub original-owner workflows can close several upstream nonautonomous recovery and source-repair gaps without new agents/schedulers/paid loops, while actual independent attestation, unknown provider charges, private custody, and prospective first-known forecast evidence may remain binding release blockers.
baseline: B0 current main exact public-first-known contract as-is: actual native CI and S1 time-based runs, not aspirational architecture. B1 single-owner manual authenticated merge evidence only. B2 mature unverified 'READY'/commented signals treated as insufficient. Compare each proposed fix with current code/test/CI, independent external evidence and existing source safety.
falsifier: Evidence of missing source/HEAD, unsupported GitHub roles, non-independent technical approval, no verifiable native receiver/job/S1 adoption, unbounded provider billing, missing external custody, no authentic first-known market clock, or added complexity outweighing actual closure. No claims of continuous autonomy or validated alpha without natural end-to-end consumer proof.
kill_condition: If source-bound public evidence and external first-known/independent authorization are insufficient, return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and exact next legitimate trigger. Never fabricate merge, paid provider usage, restored Vault, canonical BTC forecast outcome, trading signal, verified consumer or budget reconciliation.
